title: Tilapia guided dissection
subtitle: Nile Tilapia
description: A safe guided exploration of external structures, gills, body-cavity organization, major organs, and body systems.
learningGoals: Identify major external and internal structures
Follow the sequence of a supervised classroom dissection

steps.title: Observe a swimming specimen
steps.description: Begin with the generated Tilapia swimming reference video, then move into the interactive external and internal anatomy layers.
steps.prompt: Observe the tail, fin, body, and operculum movements before starting the anatomy activity.

steps.title: Inspect external anatomy
steps.description: External structures reveal how Tilapia sense their environment and move through water.
steps.prompt: Find the lateral line, operculum, and caudal fin.

steps.title: Look beneath the gill cover
steps.description: The operculum protects the gills while helping water flow across their thin respiratory surfaces.
steps.prompt: Select the exposed gills to examine their function.

steps.title: Plan the virtual incision
steps.description: A standard classroom approach begins near the vent and travels forward along the ventral surface. This is a demonstration, not procedural advice for unsupervised dissection.
steps.prompt: Select the vent, then reveal the guided incision path.

steps.title: Open the body wall
steps.description: The body wall is lifted away so the organs can be observed in their original positions before anything is moved.
steps.prompt: Open the virtual body wall to reveal the cavity.

steps.title: Map the major organs
steps.description: Notice how tightly the organs fit together. Position is an important clue when identifying an unfamiliar structure.
steps.prompt: Find the heart, liver, stomach, and swim bladder.

steps.title: Trace digestion
steps.description: Food moves from the mouth through the esophagus to the stomach, then along the folded intestine where nutrients are absorbed.
steps.prompt: Select the stomach first, followed by the intestine.

steps.title: Separate the systems
steps.description: An exploded view adds space without changing anatomical relationships. Compare the kidney, gonad, and vertebral column.
steps.prompt: Find the kidney, gonad, and vertebral column.

steps.title: Show what you discovered
steps.description: Answer three formative questions to complete your virtual dissection.
steps.prompt: Choose one answer for each question.
